messages:
maria-support: ping — BrightCart reports repeated 502s and spikes in latency from a Dedicated pool (eu-west-1) since ~09:20 UTC. customer ticket BC-1823.

alex: can you paste their error payloads?

maria-support: customer client log snippet:
```json
{"status":502,"error":"upstream throttled"}
```

maria-support: they also saw 429s and intermittent invalid_token from our auth gateway around the same time. billing notices also triggered for surges.

sre-oncall: infra alert: "dedicated-pool-eu-west scale_event oscillation detected" — 3 scale-ups and 4 scale-downs in ~8m. queued_requests metric spikes correlated with scale boundaries.

jamie: repro from the customer:
1) Warm chat with long context (seq len ~2048)
2) Burst ~12 req/s from same tenant for ~6m
3) 502/429s start around the scale transitions

toni: sounds like autoscaler cooldown is too short + KV cache rebuilds causing transient capacity loss. Did the pool hit min_replicas?

alex: pulling telemetry now...

```text
[metrics]
pool=d-1234 eu-west
min_replicas=1 current_replicas=2
scale_events=[+1 @09:21:10, -1 @09:22:00, +1 @09:22:40, -1 @09:23:15]
cpu_util=65->30->70->28
queued=120->10->130->8
```

maria-support: customer also shows auth gateway returned 401 then 429 after client retries.

jamie: probable chain: queued requests spike -> autoscaler decisions flip -> replica tear-down triggers in-flight connection drops and KV cache rebuilds -> upstream returns 502 to client. Meanwhile rate-limiter sees retries and emits 429.

sre-oncall: quick mitigation: bump scale cooldown to 180s and set min_replicas=2 for that tenant; enable pre-warm for pinned model variant. I can apply now.

deploy-bot: runbook trigger: `./infractl pools update d-1234 --min-replicas 2 --scale-cooldown 180` — executed by sre-oncall

deploy-bot: note: previous cooldown was 60s

toni: also recommend increasing request backlog threshold and enabling prefix-KV caching for that workload. consider per-tenant burst caps to prevent noisy neighbor effects.

maria-support: customer asks for ETA. can this be hotpatched?

alex: applying change now, will monitor for 20m.

jamie: please capture runtime flamegraphs during the next scale-up — looking for KV cache rebuild CPU/alloc spikes.

sre-oncall: monitoring shows queued spikes reduced post-change but one 502 at 09:40. looks tied to a single request with seq len ~4096 that caused memory churn during scale.

maria-support: customer says errors dropped significantly, but occasional 502s remain for very long-history sessions. they want a permanent fix.

toni: follow-ups: 1) enforce per-tenant burst limits; 2) make cooldown workload-aware (increase when long-seq requests observed); 3) add proportional damping to autoscaler to prevent pendulum behavior; 4) add a canary rollout for control-plane config changes.

alex: opening ticket INF-5473 with repro steps, telemetry, and proposed mitigations. assigning to eng-runtime + autoscale team.

maria-support: customer update: they accept short-term knobs and will retest. thanks team. :thumbsup:

jamie: add this to next week's postmortem + perf retro so product/solutions can advise customers on context length limits.

sre-oncall: moving to incident board and closing this thread for now.
